Job Title: QA Automation Engineer
Requirements:
- B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or related stream
- Minimum 2 years of experience in automated software testing
- Strong proficiency in Selenium, Java, automated testing, JUnit, and Postman
- Experience in API testing and regression suites
Nice to have:
- Cypress, JMeter, and CI/CD integration knowledge is a plus
- Experience with Playwright or Appium is preferred
